messages.content: When an agent applies a patch and the validation/test fails, does the agent receive the actual test output, including the failing assertion, traceback, expected/actual values, and relevant error messages? If so, is this output exactly the same information that is available during official evaluation?
messages.rawMarkdown:
When an agent applies a patch and the validation/test fails, does the agent receive the actual test output, including the failing assertion, traceback, expected/actual values, and relevant error messages?
If so, is this output exactly the same information that is available during official evaluation?
